stories.title: Waiver Wednesday: YourMomsDildo cuts A.J. Brown, ChuckJ10 wins the Denver defense, and Rome Alone has four empty lineup slots
stories.dek: $31 spent, three teams chasing the same defense, and Marco_Polo, fresh off the can, still hasn't set a lineup.
body: Waivers ran overnight and $31 changed hands. YourMomsDildo spent more than half of it: $11 on Emari Demercado and $5 on Cam Ward. Cam Ward is starting at quarterback for YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s this week, and the roster spot came from A.J. Brown, who left Week 10 with a hamstring injury and is on the New England bye. With Bijan Robinson, Harold Fannin Jr., Christian Watson and DeMario Douglas all off, YourMomsDildo needed bodies, and now has them.

The Denver defense was the hot item. ChuckJ10 put in $5, ClaytonBigsbi put in $1 and Marco_Polo put in $0, and PickensMyPukaHurts! won it. ChuckJ10 also added Cade Otton for the Kyle Pitts Sr. bye. ClaytonBigsbi settled for the Carolina defense, Chimere Dike ($8) and Chris Godwin Jr. RedDevil904 grabbed the Bears defense for $2.

Then there's Rome Alone. Marco_Polo dropped Bryce Young and Darren Waller on Tuesday and claimed Seth McGowan, Mack Hollins, Michael Mayer and the Detroit defense. As of Wednesday morning, none of them are in the lineup. Four slots are empty, quarterback included, and Corey Kiner and the Rams defense are starting on byes. Caleb Williams, Bucky Irving, Rome Odunze and Colston Loveland are all back and all on the bench. It's the Matchup of the Week against I Pulled My McCaff, Rome Alone is a 15.1-point underdog with a full lineup, and Marco_Polo just drank a can for starting zeros.

My own news is worse than it looks on paper: Drake Maye is out indefinitely, so C.J. Stroud is my quarterback for the foreseeable future. McCallyCockin(his butt) is still a 21.3-point favorite over MarcusbetterLockNjigba. Also, full disclosure, Maye was still in my starting lineup when I checked this morning. I'm fixing it before I hit publish on the next one.

Mark Andrews (16.2) on the bench over Brenton Strange (8.9) is on me.

MarcusbetterLockNjigba beat Rome Alone 99.30 to 71.60 with Drew Lock at quarterback, and Marco_Polo owes the shotgun.

columns.title: Skatabooboo is winning a fantasy football game. Write down the date.
columns.dek: 0‑10, 85.2 a week, a 10‑100 all-play, and on Friday morning it leads Your Mom’s Magic Dick 18.60 to 15.00.
body: I've covered a lot of comebacks. I've never covered a team that needed one this badly. Skatabooboo is 0‑10. It scores 85.2 points a week, the worst in the league by 15.8. Its all-play record is 10‑100, which means if it played every team every week it would still lose ten times as often as it wins.

And right now, on Friday, November 20, Skatabooboo is winning. David Montgomery scored 15.4 on Thursday night and Tyler Warren added 3.2. Your Mom’s Magic Dick got 15.0 from the Houston defense and nothing else, because nobody else on that roster has played yet. 18.60 to 15.00. ClaytonBigsbi has the lead in the Shit Show of the Week.

I'm hearing David Montgomery has become the unofficial captain of the Skatabooboo locker room and has started a pregame speech that's mostly a list of the teams that are 0‑10. Word is it's a short list, and the rest of the roster has asked him to stop reading it out loud.

Now, the facts. Your Mom’s Magic Dick is a 33.8-point favorite. Joe Burrow, Ja’Marr Chase, Trey McBride and Omarion Hampton all play this weekend, and Cavemanfsu has scored 149.46 a week over his last three. This lead is a Thursday lead. It has the life expectancy of a carton of milk. But for one weekend, the worst team in the league gets to wake up ahead. CLAYTONBIGSBI, SCREENSHOT IT!

columns.title: Thursday night film: ten league starters, graded
columns.dek: C.J. Stroud and the Houston defense earn A's. Seth McGowan, Dalton Schultz and Tyler Warren get the F's.
body: Thursday tape. Texans 26, Colts 3. Ten league starters played. Here are the grades.

C.J. Stroud, McCallyCockin(his butt): 21.46. Three touchdowns, one pick. A-minus. The real grade goes to the coach who almost started a backup on bye. That coach gets a C. Houston defense, Your Mom’s Magic Dick: 15.0. Three points allowed, 167 yards. A.

Nico Collins, I Pulled My McCaff: 15.8, with a 42-yard touchdown. B-plus. David Montgomery, Skatabooboo: 15.4. B-plus. Jonathan Taylor, JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson: 6.7. D. Tank Dell, Allen-tents & Purposes: 5.7. D. Xavier Hutchinson, MarcusbetterLockNjigba: 3.3. F. Tyler Warren: 3.2. F. Dalton Schultz: 2.1. F. Seth McGowan, Rome Alone: 1.8. F.

Sources say Jonathan Taylor has asked GeorigaGoocher for a trade to a team with a better locker-room vibe. Word is he likes what he hears about Allen-tents & Purposes. RedDevil904 reportedly plays music in there. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson has a whiteboard that says 3 percent.

Bottom line. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson leads 8.80 to 5.70 and is a 34.1-point underdog. That lead doesn't survive Josh Allen. Rome Alone is down 15.80 to 1.80 in the Matchup of the Week. Marco_Polo picked McGowan over Jordan Mason. Grade on that call: D. Thursday's MVP: Houston. Thursday's loser: anybody who started a Colt.

columns.title: How to protect a Thursday lead: four moves for the weekend
columns.dek: Skatabooboo and JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson are both ahead after one night. Here is how they stay there.
body: Two underdogs lead after Thursday. Skatabooboo is up 18.60 to 15.00 on Your Mom’s Magic Dick, and JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson is up 8.80 to 5.70 on Allen-tents & Purposes. As your Senior Fantasy Strategist, I have prepared a plan. Follow it exactly.

1. Bench everyone who hasn't played. A player on your bench cannot score you negative points. ClaytonBigsbi should move Trevor Lawrence, Cam Skattebo, Rashee Rice and the Carolina defense to the bench immediately. Skatabooboo would then finish with exactly 18.60, which beats zero, which is what I'm assuming Cavemanfsu will score if you believe hard enough.

2. GeorigaGoocher should do the same. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson leads by 3.10. Brock Purdy is a risk. Lock it in. 3. Rome Alone trails 15.80 to 1.80. Marco_Polo should start the Rams defense again. It's on bye, so it can't give up points, which is the whole job of a defense.

Word around the Skatabooboo facility is that Cam Skattebo has volunteered to sit this week to protect the lead, out of loyalty to ClaytonBigsbi. I'm told he also asked for the team to be renamed after him, and was reminded that it already sort of is.

4. tballsmccall: rename your team again. MarcusbetterLockNjigba trails 21.46 to 3.30, and a new name is a fresh start. Just pick one this network can print. In conclusion: the best defense is a good bench. Next week I'll explain why you should draft a punter.

columns.title: Thursday night by the numbers: eight starters, one defense, and the Texans are a 10.5-point favorite
columns.dek: I ran the Colts-Texans exposure for every team in the league. The results are statistically conclusive, mostly about Cavemanfsu.
body: Eight league starters play tonight. Skatabooboo has the most exposure with two, David Montgomery and Tyler Warren, and JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson also has two, Jonathan Taylor and Dalton Schultz. Your Mom’s Magic Dick, Allen-tents & Purposes, I Pulled My McCaff and MarcusbetterLockNjigba have one each. Vegas has the Texans by 10.5 with a 44.5 total.

Here is the model. The Week 11 payout goes to the highest-scoring defense. The Texans are double-digit favorites at home. Your Mom’s Magic Dick starts the Houston defense. Therefore Cavemanfsu has already won the payout, and the other 11 defenses playing Sunday and Monday are a formality. I have checked this twice and the confidence interval is just the word yes.

Sources say Jonathan Taylor has asked GeorigaGoocher for a better locker-room vibe at JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson, specifically one where he isn't the only reason anyone watches. He reportedly wants to be traded to a team above 3 percent in Erection Projections and has been seen studying the Allen-tents & Purposes depth chart.

One more number. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson is a 34.1-point underdog to Allen-tents & Purposes, the Blowie of the Week, and gets Taylor tonight against Tank Dell. If Taylor outscores Dell by 34.1, the spread is covered by one man on a Thursday. That's not analysis. That's math, and math doesn't apologize.

items.label: Matchup of the Week
items.title: I Pulled My McCaff vs. Rome Alone: the biggest total on the board, and the last playoff spot on the line
items.dek: A 260.6 total, the most points in the league against the team holding the sixth seed, and Marco_Polo still has a can to drink.
body: This is the game with the most points in it. I Pulled My McCaff scores 141.8 a week, the best in the league, with an 86‑24 all-play. Rome Alone scores 118.8 a week. Put them together and the total is 260.6, highest of Week 11 by 10.9.

And it's the one with the stakes. Rome Alone is 6‑4, sixth in the standings and at 62 percent in Erection Projections, the last team inside the line. Your Mom’s Magic Dick is right behind at 43 percent. I Pulled My McCaff is at 96 percent to make it and 46 percent for a bye, so Hing1eMcCring13berry is playing for the top two.

The byes cut both ways. I Pulled My McCaff loses Blake Corum, KC Concepcion Jr. and Dylan Sampson to byes, and Kenneth Walker III is out, so Christian McCaffrey carries the backfield. Rome Alone gets Caleb Williams, Bucky Irving, Rome Odunze and Colston Loveland back but loses the Rams defense. That cuts a 23.1-point gap to 15.1.
The pick: I Pulled My McCaff by 15.1, 69 percent. Marco_Polo has the bodies back. Now he has to put them in the lineup.
items.result: After Thursday: I Pulled My McCaff 15.80, Rome Alone 1.80. Nico Collins 15.8, Seth McGowan 1.8.

items.label: Shit Show of the Week
items.title: Your Mom’s Magic Dick vs. Skatabooboo: the lowest total of the week, and an 0‑10 team
items.dek: 205.2 projected points combined, 55 below the Matchup of the Week. Skatabooboo has been eliminated for weeks.
body: The sewer game this week is Your Mom’s Magic Dick against Skatabooboo, with a projected total of 205.2, the lowest on the board by 19.0. Skatabooboo scores 85.2 a week, the worst in the league by 15.8, and is 0‑10.

Playoff implications: one side only. Skatabooboo is out. Your Mom’s Magic Dick is 5‑5 at 43 percent, so the only thing that matters here is Cavemanfsu not becoming the answer to a trivia question by losing to the winless team.

Your Mom’s Magic Dick is hot, three straight wins at 149.46 a week, and only loses bench guys (Matthew Stafford, Konata Mumpfield, Denzel Boston) to byes. Skatabooboo gets Courtland Sutton back from his bye but loses Tutu Atwell. Cam Skattebo scored 27.2 last week and is the only reason to watch.
The pick: Your Mom’s Magic Dick by 33.8, 86 percent. ClaytonBigsbi, there's always Week 12.
items.result: After Thursday: Skatabooboo 18.60, Your Mom’s Magic Dick 15.00. The 0‑10 team leads.

items.label: Blowie of the Week
items.title: Allen-tents & Purposes over JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson by 34.1: the biggest spread of Week 11
items.dek: The first-place team, three straight wins and its backups back from byes, against a team at 3 percent.
body: Allen-tents & Purposes scores 140.1 a week with a 79‑31 all-play. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson scores 108.0. That's a 32.1-point gap before anyone checks the injury report.

Then you check it. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson loses Zach Charbonnet to the Seattle bye, and Jaylen Waddle and Jake Ferguson are out. Allen-tents & Purposes loses Matthew Golden and the Seahawks defense but gets Dallas Goedert, Jonah Coleman and D’Andre Swift back from Week 10 byes. That's 34.1.

Stakes: Allen-tents & Purposes is at 84 percent for a bye and wants the top seed. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson is 5‑5 and at 3 percent; it needs to win out and get help. Brock Purdy scored 33.66 last week, and GeorigaGoocher needs another one of those plus a Jahmyr Gibbs dud.
The pick: Allen-tents & Purposes by 34.1, 86 percent. RedDevil904 should be done by Sunday afternoon.
